dimensions.assessment: Affects rural hospitals, critical access hospitals meeting surgical thresholds, and anesthesiologists providing services in those facilities.
dimensions.evidence: payment to such hospital for physicians' services that are anesthesia services furnished by a physician who is an anesthesiologist in such hospital shall be made on a reasonable cost basis.

dimensions.assessment: Changes reimbursement structures from Part B billing to Part A reasonable cost basis for eligible rural hospitals.
dimensions.evidence: provide payment under part A of the Medicare program on a reasonable cost basis for anesthesia services

dimensions.assessment: Alters Medicare reimbursement formulas for specified hospitals, shifting payment mechanisms, though exact aggregate dollar impacts are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: payment to such hospital for physicians' services that are anesthesia services... shall be made on a reasonable cost basis.

dimensions.assessment: Amends specific sections of the Social Security Act regarding Medicare Part A and Part B payment rules for rural hospitals.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to provide payment under part A of the Medicare program on a reasonable cost basis

dimensions.assessment: Provides an ongoing statutory modification to Medicare payment rules for qualifying rural and critical access hospitals.
dimensions.evidence: For cost reporting periods beginning on or after the date that is 1 year after the date of the enactment

importance_detail.rationale: Modifies Medicare payment methodology for anesthesiologists in certain rural and critical access hospitals that have low surgical volumes.
